caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box-like object made of metal with ornate detailing, elevated on four curved legs that form an integrated base. The main body of the object is a light tan or beige color, with a textured appearance, bordered by dark, possibly black or dark gray, ornamental trim. The trim includes decorative edges and floral designs. On the right side, there is a door featuring a panel with a raised, ornate pattern and two small round handles. The top of the object is flat with a circular, slightly raised lid or plate, and another smaller, flat circular element beside it, both rendered in the same dark color as the trim. The overall composition places the object centrally on a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects or scenery.
